title: Console: label API keys as test vs prod + wire to onboarding checklist validation
author: Kaitlyn Nguyen
description: Context: As part of the guided onboarding checklist (Phase 1: Hosted API), we need a reliable signal for “prod-mode API key created” and we’ve repeatedly seen 401s from users mixing keys/environments (SUP-9244). This PR updates the API key creation UX to explicitly label keys as “Test” vs “Production”, stores that label server-side, and emits a checklist-friendly validation event when a production key is created. Summary of changes: (1) Console UX: Key creation modal now includes an “Environment” selector (Test/Production) with copy: Test = local dev/experiments; Production = shipped workloads. Production selection shows an inline warning about rotating, restricting exposure, and monitoring usage. Keys are displayed with an environment pill (TEST/PROD) in the keys table and key details drawer. (2) Backend/API: Adds `environment` field to the key metadata model (`test` | `prod`) with default = `test` for newly created keys when unspecified (and for existing keys on read). No behavior change in auth enforcement; this is a labeling + telemetry primitive only in Phase 1. (3) Onboarding integration: When a key is created with environment=prod, Console emits `onboarding.step.completed` for step_id `create_prod_api_key` (and also emits the underlying `api_key.created` event with `environment=prod`). Events use the existing allowlist + redaction rules (no key material, no user-entered notes). (4) Permissions: Environment selector is only shown to users who can create keys; keys list shows environment badge to anyone with `api_keys:read` (no new permissions). (5) Tests: Adds unit tests for model defaulting + API serialization; adds Playwright coverage for creating a prod key and verifying UI badge + emitted event (mocked). Non-goals: (a) No separate “prod” vs “test” key types at the gateway layer (auth is unchanged). (b) No automatic enforcement for “prod keys must have IP allowlist” etc. Those belong in the broader first production launch checklist doc + future validation signals. Rollout: gated behind `console_onboarding_checklist_v1` feature flag for now. When flag is off, environment selector is hidden and keys behave exactly as before (environment defaults to test behind the scenes but is not surfaced).
commits: console(api-keys): add environment selector + badges in keys table
api: extend API key metadata with environment and defaults
telemetry(onboarding): emit prod key completion event w/ dedupe key
tests: add Playwright coverage for prod key creation + analytics emit
copy: tighten modal microcopy + warning text for production keys
changed_areas: Console: API Keys page + create-key modal + key details drawer. Backend: API key model + REST handlers for create/list. Telemetry: onboarding event emit wrapper. Tests: unit tests (backend) + Playwright (console).
illustrative_snippet:
UI: Create key modal now includes Environment selector.
- Environment: [Test] [Production]
- Helper text: “Use Production keys for shipped workloads. Do not embed in client apps.”
Telemetry: when environment=prod, emit onboarding.step.completed with step_id=create_prod_api_key and project_id/org_id (no key value).
review_conversation: Dylan Brooks (review): “Looks good overall. Two asks: (1) make sure existing keys don’t suddenly show PROD by accident; default should be TEST everywhere. (2) ensure telemetry can’t include key material even if someone changes code later.” Kaitlyn Nguyen (author): “Ack. Defaulting is server-side to `test` when null/undefined; UI only renders pill when env is present (and env is always `test` from API). Added serializer tests for backward-compat. Telemetry payload uses allowlisted properties and never passes the key token; added a regression test that snapshots emitted props.” Chloe Martin (review): “Backend change: please confirm DB migration strategy. Are we adding a column or storing in JSON metadata?” Kaitlyn Nguyen: “Storing in `api_keys.metadata.environment` (jsonb) for now; no migration needed. We can promote to a dedicated column later if we need indexing. Added validation to only allow `test|prod`.” Marissa Cole (review): “Copy: can we align with checklist wording (‘Production key’) and add link to docs from modal?” Kaitlyn Nguyen: “Updated labels to ‘Production key’. Added a small ‘Learn more’ link to /docs/onboarding/production-keys (behind the same flag).” Nikhil Sharma (review): “Do we want the checklist step to be ‘Create a production key’ or ‘Switch to production mode’?” Kaitlyn Nguyen: “Wiring to step_id=create_prod_api_key per PM guidance (PM-483). Happy to rename step_id later; this is behind flag and uses the centralized step registry.” Approvals: Dylan Brooks approved after changes; Chloe Martin approved; Marissa Cole approved with minor copy nits addressed.
